description: Two-layer Hall uncertainty structure (project decision 2026-09-26). Layer 1 (calibration nuisance) is uncertainty in what the P5 experiment WAS; it is marginalized when admitting transport closures and is NEVER a Vyovrinda design variable or an architecture-trade dimension. Layer 2 (transferable) is the credible set of Hall transport closures that survives after marginalizing layer 1; each member is evaluated on Vyovrinda's own geometry and B(z) to produce design-specific Hall maps. Members are an UNWEIGHTED scenario set (no probabilities) until evidence (e.g. N2 validation) justifies elimination or weighting.
